usage: agentbreeder registry trust [-h] [--list | --remove] [--whole-host]
                                   [--private] [--yes] [--json]
                                   [URL]

positional arguments:
  URL           scheme://host/path-prefix

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
  --list        List trusted prefixes
  --remove      Remove URL from the list
  --whole-host  Allow a bare host (trusts every repository)
  --private     Allow a host on a private or loopback address
  --yes         Do not ask for confirmation
  --json
